one_x_two.market_role: synchronized de-vigged 1X2 is the preferred probability baseline when PIT-qualified
one_x_two.football_role: validated dynamic strength, lineup, manager, xG/event and schedule context may learn residual information only under leakage-safe validation

total_goals.market_role: synchronized O/U ladder is the preferred market information source; one isolated O/U line cannot fabricate the full 0-7+ distribution
total_goals.football_role: NB/formal total remains a prior/baseline; xG, shot quantity/quality, pace, lineup and validated dynamic-state context may challenge the prior only with PIT-safe OOF evidence

exact_score.role: reconciliation layer, not the upstream source of all football information
prior_sources: PIT correct-score/BTTS/team-total evidence when independently validated

allowed_uses_initially: candidate residual feature after explicit ablation
derive handicap settlement probabilities from the accepted final score matrix
asian_handicap.activation_gate: may affect probabilities only after a strictly chronological ablation proves incremental proper-score benefit without degrading the three primary targets

team_state.old_policy_to_replace_in_challenger: hard current-season reset with target-team strength estimated only from target-season matches
team_state.new_policy: cross-season dynamic prior with no future smoothing; old information decays and current-season observations progressively dominate
team_state.preferred_lineage: adaptive_commensurate_strength_v470 / independently retrained state-space equivalent because this lineage already has competition-specific OOF/promotion machinery
team_state.hedge_experiment_status: STATE_SOURCE_EXPERIMENT_ONLY_NOT_CHAMPION; V6.23.0 fast screen increased Top1 slightly but regressed aggregate 1X2 Brier/RPS/Log Loss and therefore cannot become the probability state champion
team_state.hedge_experiment_role: mechanical cross-season/no-reset implementation test with formal_weight=0
team_state.same_day_rule: predict all matches on a calendar date before any result update
team_state.roster_change_rule: roster/manager evidence changes uncertainty or residual context; it may not be converted to a hand-written probability adjustment

market_layer.old_position_rejected: market as a late read-only opinion after the score generator has already determined all marginals
market_layer.pit_requirement: original timestamp plus synchronized 1X2/OU window for formal-quality use

validation.random_100_role: fast fault screen only; never promotion evidence
system_gate: accepted 1X2 and total marginals preserved by final matrix
no primary metric materially degrades in worst rolling windows
independent prospective frozen evidence before formal promotion
validation.promotion_rule: head-specific improvement is judged at the module gate; final promotion is judged at the system gate. A 1X2 head is not rejected merely because it does not independently improve exact score before reconciliation.
